materials.floor: Muted concrete with warm wear, cracking, and enough contrast to separate future props from open walking space.
materials.wall: Dusty beige garage plaster lit by warm fixtures so the room stays grounded and readable.
materials.trim: Dark brown structural trim and framing that anchors the DOS-style silhouette language.
materials.shadow: Soft industrial corner shading that deepens the room without pushing the MVP into heavy lighting effects.

rules: Keep the garage shell readable at a glance with strong floor-to-wall separation.
Reserve teal accents for utility bands, doors, or equipment so expansion props can share the same language.
Favor broad low-frequency texture and crisp silhouettes over noisy detail.
